summary: Localize OH0252700 to a custom Ohio State Columbus-campus footprint rather than Columbus city or Franklin County.
notes: Use the official Columbus campus map and OSU planning materials to build the footprint around the bounded Columbus campus property system on both sides of the Olentangy River, including the mapped academic, residential, athletics, west-campus, and campus-core medical areas plus immediately adjacent public-property segments. Exclude the off-campus University District joint-patrol area, generic Clery noncampus geography, and remote Wexner or airport facilities unless a current OSUPD source directly places them in the primary police footprint. If custom geometry is unavailable, keep broad overlap rather than forcing a Columbus or Franklin proxy.
